title: Fasteners - Type Chart
description: Wood screws, machine screws, sheet metal screws, self drilling SMS and more.

components.content:
## Fastener Categories

Wood Screws, Machine Screws, Sheet Metal Screws, Self Drilling SMS, Hex Bolts, Carriage Bolts, Lag Bolts, Set Screws, Socket Screws, Eye Bolts, Eye Lags, U-Bolts, J-Bolts, Hanger Bolts

## Head Styles

Flat, Oval, Pan, Truss, Round, Hex, Hex Washer, Slotted Hex Washer, Socket Cap, Button

## Drive Types

Phillips and Frearson, Slotted, Combination, Socket, Hex, Allen

## Nut Types

Hex, Nylon Insert Lock, Jam, Nylon Insert Jam Lock, Wing, Cap, Acorn, Flange, Tee, Square, Prevailing Torque Lock, K-Lock or Keep, Coupling

## Washer Types

Flat, Fender, Finishing, Split Lock, External Toot Lock, Internal Toot Lock, Square, Dock, Ogee

**Reference:** [Bolt Depot Fastener Type Chart](http://www.boltdepot.com/fastener-information/Printable-Tools/Type-Chart.pdf)
